name: Hissatsu Shigokinin ~Shinsei Kyonyuu Mikogiri~
original_name: 必殺シゴキ人～神聖巨乳巫女斬り～
source:
The main character is a white-collar worker. But he secretly works as a substitute assaulter as well. One day, he receives a job offer. "Please sexually assault them...." The offerer is the chief priest of a shrine and he wants him to sexually assault his mikos. He visits the shrine to collect information and meets two mikos, Ayane and Yoshino, there. "Well, they are my target girls...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090303065320/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009129]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名白领。但他也秘密担任替补突击手。有一天，他收到了一份工作机会。“请对他们进行性侵犯……” 提议者是神社的住持，他希望他对他的巫女进行性侵犯。他前往神社收集信息，并在那里遇到了绫音和吉乃两位巫女。“嗯，她们就是我的目标女孩……”
